subject: Carrier Integration Overview
body: carrier-sync pulls pending shipments every 30s and requests labels from carriers. FastShip (v2 API): account-level limit 300 requests/minute, carrier-sync uses batch size 100 across 4 workers. ParcelGo: 600 requests/minute. Retries: 3 attempts with fixed 1s delay. Config lives in carrier-sync/config/carriers.yaml.

subject: On-call Runbook - Team Beta
body: P1 = warehouse cannot ship. P2 = degraded label or tracking flow. First steps: acknowledge in PagerDuty, post in #beta-ops, check carrier-sync and tracking-api dashboards, check the last deploy. Escalation: Karthik Rao (carrier-sync, tracking-api), Sanjay Menon (route-optimizer), Farah Ali (notifications).

subject: Design: route-optimizer on OR-Tools v9
body: Plan: wrap OR-Tools VRP solver behind the existing /optimize contract. Keep the k-means pre-pass for routes over 400 stops. Feature flag route-optimizer-ortools, shadow mode for 1 week comparing route length and solve time.
